messages.subject: Re: iterations
parts:
On 04/09/2013 11:13 PM, merm.m...@gmail.com wrote:
> How do I increase the number of iterations?

You can set the maximum number of iterations as follows:

example(cfa)
fit <- cfa(HS.model, data=HolzingerSwineford1939, control=list(iter.max=20))

(which in this example is too few, and the model will not converge
within 20 iterations)

The current default in lavaan (0.5-12) is iter.max=10000, so I don't
think there is a need to increase it. You can tinker with other
parameters of the optimizer by passing them through the 'control'
argument. See ?nlminb for all the optimizer control parameters.

Yves.
